service.description: Read-only: returns the full (or keyword-filtered) DeviceType and AssetClass Enumeration trees, every norm-derived ProductCategory (productCategoryTypeEnumId= PctRegulatory - excludes plm-bom-import's own BOM-derived categories, a different mechanism) with its linked ProductFeatureGroup(s)/ProductFeature(s) inlined, plus any norm-derived ProductFeature that exists but is NOT linked to any ProductFeatureGroup (standaloneFeatures - e.g. the ISO 12100/ISO-TR-22100-4 safety/security features, which check#DeviceSafetyExposure reads as flat evidence rather than through a category/group traversal; found by a real gap - these were previously invisible here entirely). Deliberately no automatic ranking/matching against the evidence text - DeviceType/ AssetClass labels are 2-4 words, too short for reliable semantic similarity against paragraph-length evidence (verified: Enumeration.description is the only text field, no richer description exists). The calling agent reads this list and judges the match itself (norm-product-classification skill, Workflow B), then calls classify#Product to apply the decision.

parameter.name: keyword
parameter.description: Optional filter, matched against description (DeviceType/AssetClass) or category/feature description - omit to get the full vocabulary.

service.description: Applies a classification decision already made by the calling agent (per norm-product-classification skill, Workflow B - hierarchical, most-specific-first: try deviceTypeEnumId only for genuinely electronic/automation components, always try assetClassEnumId, independently try productCategoryIds). Updates Asset.classEnumId for every real Asset instance of this Product (a Product can have more than one physical Asset instance - confirmed, not assumed, e.g. PROD_SIE_XB208 has 2); updates Device.deviceTypeEnumId too wherever a Device exists for one of those Assets. Ensures ProductCategoryMember for each chosen category (idempotent - same ensure-membership pattern as attach#ProductFamilyContentFromPath, skips categories the product already belongs to). At least one of deviceTypeEnumId/assetClassEnumId/productCategoryIds must be given - this service never guesses on its own, it only applies an already-made decision.

parameter.name: deviceTypeEnumId
parameter.description: Only for electronic/automation components - omit for purely mechanical/electromechanical ones.

parameter.name: productCategoryIds
parameter.description: Real, existing PctRegulatory ProductCategory ids from find#ClassificationVocabulary - never a category invented on the spot.

parameter.name: rationale
parameter.description: Short justification (evidence used), stored on the MathModelRun for audit.
